title: Single-shot: FizzBuzz CLI
taskPrompt: Write a Node.js script named fizzbuzz.js in the current directory. It reads an integer N from process.argv[2]. For i = 1 to N: if i is divisible by both 3 and 5 use "FizzBuzz", if only by 3 use "Fizz", if only by 5 use "Buzz", otherwise use the number itself as a string. Print the resulting array of N strings as JSON to stdout via console.log(JSON.stringify(...)) — one JSON array, nothing else printed. Run it yourself with a small N before calling finish to confirm the output looks right.
